article: Two short videos: Tottenham's ball boy and Starbucks
scope: Read and compared the complete Japanese article and all twelve translations. Checked the historical date against Git history; translated the article prose, titles and descriptions; checked the Tottenham ball-boy account against the club's official report; checked that the original TikTok and YouTube destinations are present; inspected dates, embeds, metadata, and translation consistency.
findings: Removed the duplicate future date (2026-09-24) from all 13 files and restored the original publication date, 2024-08-25, confirmed in repository history; recorded the review date as lastmod.
Translated the Japanese TikTok embed caption and tags out of translated pages by replacing the embed with a direct link to the original post.

Replaced unsupported phrasing that the ball boy 'saved the team' with the club's account: Callum Hynes quickly returned the ball, helping set up the equalizer against Olympiacos; José Mourinho praised his quick thinking and thanked him.
Added context about third-party playback availability and links to the original TikTok/YouTube destinations and the official Tottenham report.

post/ショート動画リンク/index.en.md.summary: Compared the complete translation with the Japanese article and Tottenham Hotspur's official account; corrected dates, translated all text, and aligned the video descriptions and links.

meaning.note: Compared the complete Japanese article and all twelve translations. Removed the duplicated/future date, restored the original 2024-08-25 publication date, translated all article text, and documented the two videos and playback limits.

terminology.note: Checked football terminology (ball boy/gandula/recogepelotas), the proper names Tottenham, Olympiacos, Callum Hynes and José Mourinho, and localized headings in all editions.

mathematics.note: The article contains no mathematical claims or formulas.

code.note: The article contains no code or commands.

links.note: Checked Tottenham's official report for the ball boy account; retained the original TikTok and YouTube destinations. The source posts themselves may be unavailable or region-restricted.

limitations: AI-assisted review; no human or native-speaker certification.

The original TikTok post and YouTube video were retained, but their current playback, regional availability, and embedded display can change; the YouTube title/content could not be independently confirmed from the available official page metadata.
Tottenham's official report corroborates the historical ball-boy account, but does not verify the present-day availability or every claim in the third-party TikTok post.
